title: Fail closed when semantic layout drift prevents manifest, IR, and object emission

diagnostics.message: cyclic Objective-C interface inheritance cannot produce a stable ivar layout
runtime metadata export blocked: runtime metadata export shape drift detected before lowering

mode_matrix.name: native-manifest-object-ir-truth-gate-negative
abi_requirements: Cyclic interface inheritance emits deterministic O3P150 and O3S260 diagnostics before a manifest, IR, or object artifact is accepted as a claim source
The truth-gate report performs two negative compiler runs and verifies deterministic diagnostic output
Rejected input does not produce module.manifest.json, module.ll, or module.obj in the checked negative scratch runs
Scratch artifacts may be regenerated only outside the checked source inputs and committed report contracts

negative_requirements: No manifest-only, IR-only, or object-only success path may satisfy the gate
Missing artifact, hash drift, object section drift, or unsupported negative emission must fail the gate
Public claim reports remain separate durable inputs and must not be inferred from tmp scratch output
